extracted.name: Banana Milkshake
extracted.description: Skip the takeout window at Sonic for a banana milkshake, and use this recipe to make your own copycat version with milk and a frozen banana.
ingredient_lines: 1 frozen banana, partially thawed and mashed
0.5 cup milk, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Mix banana and milk together in a cup or bowl until desired consistency is reached.
